follow-up time: From premature rupture of membranes (PROM) to delivery
exposure: Gestational age at PROM (28-33 weeks vs 34-36 weeks)
Time from PROM to delivery (<48 hours vs ≥48 hours)
cohort: 400 primiparous women with premature rupture of membranes (PROM) at 28-36 weeks of gestation
finding: In pregnant women with PROM who are not at full term, a greater gestational week is associated with a lower rate of adverse delivery outcomes, while a longer time interval between membrane rupture and delivery is associated with a higher rate of adverse delivery outcomes.
mod_finding: The study found that women who delivered at a later gestational age (34-36 weeks) had a lower proportion of vaginal deliveries and a higher proportion of assisted vaginal deliveries and cesarean sections compared to women who delivered earlier (28-33 weeks).
